subject: Medford High School Project OPM Selection
overview: The School Committee selected a firm to manage the high school building project and voted to remain a no-school-choice district for the upcoming year. They also approved various policy resolutions regarding family communication, supply chain preparedness, and food allergy awareness.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, grants, field trips, and the meeting minutes for April 14, 2025.

items.title: 2025-2026 School Choice Recommendation
items.summary: Voted to continue as a no-school-choice district for the 2025-2026 school year due to enrollment capacity issues in elementary and vocational programs.

items.title: Budget Transfers
items.summary: Approved transfers totaling $25,971.41 for various instructional supplies and equipment maintenance, including minor repairs to the McGlynn Auditorium sound system.

items.title: 2025-2026 School Committee Calendar
items.summary: Approved the draft meeting calendar for the upcoming school year with an amendment to include a provisional third meeting in June.

items.title: MSBA High School Project Update
items.summary: Member Graham announced the unanimous selection of Left Field as the Owner's Project Manager (OPM) to lead the feasibility study for the new high school project.

items.title: MASC/MASS Conference Delegates
items.summary: Nominated Member Ruseau as the voting delegate and Member Intoppa as the alternate for the annual joint conference in November.

items.title: Reaffirmation of MASC Resolutions
items.summary: Approved a resolution to reaffirm support for statewide policies regarding sanctuary laws for transgender students, special education reserve funds, and educator representation on the state board.

items.title: Family Communication Protocols Resolution
items.summary: Referred a proposal to the Family Engagement and Communication Subcommittee to establish formal protocols for notifying families about enrollment lotteries and academic transitions.

items.title: Classroom Supply Lists and Supply Chain Scarcity
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the district to identify essential supplies and release lists to families as early as possible to mitigate the impact of potential supply chain disruptions and rising costs.

items.title: Food Allergy Awareness Week Proclamation
items.summary: Proclaimed May 11-17, 2025, as Food Allergy Awareness Week and received an update on district nursing initiatives and staff training for allergy emergencies.
